import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router'; import { SalesService } from 'src/app/services/sales.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-payment', templateUrl: './payment.component.html', styleUrls: ['./payment.component.css'], }) export class PaymentComponent implements OnInit { orderData: any = {}; isLoading = false; paymentSuccess = false; totalAmount = 0; constructor( private route: ActivatedRoute, private router: Router, private salesService: SalesService, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { // Get order data from navigation state or localStorage const navigation = window.history.state; if (navigation.cartData) { this.orderData = navigation.cartData; } else { const savedCart = localStorage.getItem('checkout_cart'); if (savedCart) { this.orderData = JSON.parse(savedCart); } } // Calculate total amount if (this.orderData.items) { this.totalAmount = this.orderData.items.reduce( (sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0, ); } } processPayment(): void { this.isLoading = true; const buyerName = localStorage.getItem('username'); if (!buyerName) { alert('Please login first'); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } // Create an order for each item in cart const orders = this.orderData.items?.map((item: any) => ({ itemName: item.name, buyer: buyerName, price: item.price, quantity: item.quantity, delivered: false, orderStatus: 'PENDING', orderDate: new Date(), shippingAddress: localStorage.getItem('shippingAddress') || 'Not provided', })); if (!orders || orders.length === 0) { alert('No items in cart'); this.router.navigate(['/cart']); return; } // Save each order to database const savePromises = orders.map((order: any) => this.salesService.createOrder(order).toPromise(), ); Promise.all(savePromises) .then(() => { this.isLoading = false; this.paymentSuccess = true; // Clear cart after successful payment localStorage.removeItem('checkout_cart'); localStorage.removeItem('cart'); setTimeout(() => { this.router.navigate(['/orders'], { queryParams: { payment: 'success' }, }); }, 2000); }) .catch((err) => { this.isLoading = false; console.error('Error placing order:', err); alert('Failed to place order. Please try again.'); }); } // ✅ Add the missing skipPayment method skipPayment(): void { if ( confirm( 'Are you sure you want to skip payment? Your order will not be placed.', ) ) { this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } } formatPrice(price: number): string { return price?.toLocaleString('en-IN') || '0'; } }
